latency.scope: Observed local HTTP search requests in this bounded proof, including rejection checks

witness: Published wrapper has a required reference to the normally text-withdrawn case; case head is revoked, wrapper head stays active only during proof

cleanup.wrapper: ordinary CMS unpublish if still active
cleanup.case: normal withdrawal revokes head; unpublish only if an interrupted preparation left it active

limits: Measurements cover only these owned local requests.
No full endpoint performance bound is claimed.
Mutation routes are restricted to the three new owned identities; catalog, home, configuration and worker routes are outside the allowlist.
